description: Read one current OFAC, UK or EU sanctions entry by list and exact id from sanctions_search_entries or sanctions_list_changes. Use sanctions_search_entries for name matching; use sanctions_list_changes to investigate removals. Returns entry with names/aliases, programmes, countries, first_seen/last_changed and proof containing the official file URL, SHA-256 and source date. Unknown or removed ids return entry_not_listed. This reads stored snapshots, not a real-time clearance decision. Free keyless allowance: 10 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

id.description: The listing's id on that list, e.g. 36 or RUS0849

list.description: The list Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu; e.g. ofac-sdn.

name: sanctions_get_entry
title: Get one current sanctions entry
